blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Corporate and government procurement records are set to take center stage on Monday, Day 27 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. The House prosecutors are expected to present witnesses from the Civil Service Commission, Securities and Exchange Commission and Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System to examine Duterte’s declared business interests and alleged government transactions involving companies linked to her./dp READ: ICYMI: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Week 11 highlights...
